services.name: Weddings & Rentals
services.desc: Quaint and charming, this little chapel on the hillside provides the perfect setting for a classic, timeless wedding. Salvaged wooden pews seat approximately 50 guests. Celebrate with the ringing of the church bell, made by the same company who made the Liberty Bell. Featuring our collection of historic, architectural sculptures from around Lynchburg, our Shrub Garden offers an excellent location for the couple looking for a charming, garden venue. Tie the knot in the shade of century-old sugar maple trees. The garden wall and boxwood hedge enclose this stately section, complete with seating area and “gazebo” (speakers belvedere).
